card.name: Header and title-line details
card.fires_on: Marked words in document headers and title lines, such as the closing mark of a manual page name, the end of a proper name, or items in a list of paper-cover details. The word sits where a header field ends.

modes.label: Manual page headers
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a section number in a Linux manual page title.

modes.label: Ends of proper names
modes.description: The last piece of a split company or place name.

modes.label: Paper cover-page fields
modes.description: Words in a list of items a student must put on a cover page.
modes.example: title of paper, student name, course name and section, date,<< professor>> name.

card.plain: It fires at the ends of headers, titles and name lists, where one field finishes and the next begins.
